title: ARI-RQGM governance result cache record
description: One line of the append-only {ckpt}/rqgm_governance_cache.jsonl (docs/plans/ari_rqgm/12 §5.5/§6.2, owned by Task 12). cache_key = sha256(artifact_hash \x1f prompt_hash \x1f role \x1f epoch_id \x1f input_context_hash \x1f output_schema_hash)[:16]; created_at is provenance only and NEVER part of the key (P2 — no wall-clock inputs). Entries are never invalidated in place: a retired prompt's entries simply stop being addressable because its prompt_hash never recurs in a lookup (invariant 13). Replay lookup rule: replaying case c against prompt p computes the key with epoch_id = c.origin_epoch_id and prompt_hash = p.hash. Additive-only evolution.
